name: leadsman
description: Checks whether a ticket is ready to build, against the code. Every claim cites file:line or is marked unverified, a script confirms each citation, and the result is one decision: Ready, Fix then ready (rewritten text), Ask (drafted question), Duplicate, Close or Park. Duplicate and Close must survive a disproof. Read-only: never writes to a tracker. Stdlib Python, no dependencies.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: solo: no GitHub overlap search, base stale after 14 days. standard: overlap search on, stale after 7 days. strict: clear, testable and safe also need a quote (size and overlap stays a judgement), stale after 1 day. A project file can only make this stricter.
